title: At its Made on YouTube event, YouTube unveils Custom Feeds, an LLM-powered feature that lets users generate and save tailored homepage video feeds, for US users (Reece Rogers/Wired)
summary: Reece Rogers / Wired: At its Made on YouTube event, YouTube unveils Custom Feeds, an LLM-powered feature that lets users generate and save tailored homepage video feeds, for US users — In YouTube's latest update, viewers can tweak what the algorithm shows on their front page and curate it to a specific vibe.
